items.description: The shipping halt, which hit four countries, follows a new U.S. rule that would require licenses for companies in the countries to buy advanced A.I. chips.

items.title: Trump’s Latest Tariffs Revive Focus on Pressuring China

items.title: Trump Tried to Cripple Huawei. Now It Is Central to China’s A.I. Push.

items.title: Lured by High Salaries, Some Brazilians Were Duped Into Fighting for Russia

items.title: Brazilian Duped Into Fighting for Russia: ‘War Is Hell’

items.title: Democrats Confront a Familiar Question: How Are You Going to Pay for That?

items.title: Bipartisan Desire to Regulate A.I. Faces Obstacles in Congress

items.title: Trump Administration’s Cuts to SNAP Threaten Free School Meals

items.title: To Many, Turkeys Are Dinner. To These Artists, They’re the Perfect Muse.
